--- Page 1 (Beckerman_86a) --- Dear Jobe: Long time no write - but have been very well occupied and my lousy days are things of the past. Strictly G.I. now and "on the ball" 7 days a week. It all happened about 6 weeks ago. I am now assigned to an outfit that will be leaving very shortly (I think) for parts unknown. My time has been divided between radio training and overseas training. At present I have all my equipment and my squadron is ready. We are awaiting orders for our departure to a P.O.E. - Probably N.Y. I've been lucky enough and managed to secure a 6 day furlough from which I returned 2 days ago. As deal as things were at home it was paradise. I have very little news for you and probably you are already informed. Iw Fine was in N.Y. on furlough the same time I was and he and Goldstein finally got hitched. And Lieutenant Cornblatt was in - he is in the transportatin --- Page 2 (Beckerman_86b) --- branch of the army. He just returned from a trip to Casablanca and was going on another voyage when I left. Charles Green has been "Coast Guarding" around the world on Convoy duty. Bassow has just left Florida for a P.O.E and I hope he can get leave if he is near home. It's nice to hear that you are leading a nice life but being selfish as I am I hope we all get our discharge papers soon and you have to leave that job in mine. But shit - it looks like a long, long war. Abrams & Bake are both writing from Africa. Carlo's name was mentioned in the Times. He took part in a daring raid on an apio Convoy. Nothing more to say except to long & write. Private for the duration, [illegible] Chilbo address: 274 Ord. Maint. Co. AA Camp Davis, N.C.
